Package kieker.analysis.generic.source.rewriter

Interface ITraceMetadataRewriter

All Known Implementing Classes:
NoneTraceMetadataRewriter, PlainTraceMetadataRewriter
public interface ITraceMetadataRewriter
In case TraceMetadata records are received out of order, i.e., not before the first trace related record, different strategies can be applied. This interface provides a common interface for the implementation of such strategies.
